# Incident report INC-0611 — Loss of video streams on 22 pilot cameras

Prepared by: Vivek Anand (Field Engineer, PredCo), reviewed by Farhan Siddiqui (Ardent IT & OT) | 12 Jun 2026

## Summary

From 9 Jun 2026 18:40 to 11 Jun 2026 11:55 (about 41 hours), 22 of the 40 pilot cameras (packing 9, conveyor 7, raw mill 6)
sent no usable stream to the ViewOS edge servers. No safety alerts were raised for those cameras during that time.
The control room was not told until the morning of 10 Jun.

## Cause

The client's CCTV maintenance contractor applied a firmware update to NVR-2 and NVR-3 on 9 Jun evening. The update reset
RTSP sub-stream settings to a codec the edge decoder did not accept. The ViewOS software showed the cameras as "connected"
because the network link was up; it did not check that frames were actually arriving.

## Impact

- About 900 camera-hours with no detection (22 cameras × 41 hours).
- Median alert acknowledgement time rose that week, as in-charges were reassigned to manual rounds.
- No safety incident occurred during the gap.

# ardent-drishti-edge

Site deployment of ViewOS for Ardent Cement Works, Bhadrapur ("Project Drishti").
Private repository: github.com/predco-delivery/ardent-drishti-edge

## What runs where

- 3 × edge GPU servers (10.20.4.11–13) in the Bhadrapur server room, OT VLAN 40
- `detector/` — person, helmet, hi-vis vest, face-shield models (YOLO-family, site-tuned)
- `zones/` — restricted-zone and hot-zone polygons per camera (`configs/zones_bhadrapur.yaml`)
- `alerts/` — alert bus, WhatsApp text gateway (text only, no images), control-room console at 10.20.4.15:8080
- `health/` — stream health monitor (added v1.4 after INC-0611)
- `gate/` — CR-03 gate turnaround: ANPR events G1–G4 joined with SAP weighbridge feed (via PredCo Data Core connector)

## Counting rules (agreed with EHS, 22 Apr 2026)

- A "person observed" is one tracked person in one camera within a 10-minute window. The same person seen by two cameras counts twice.
- Compliance = tracked persons with both helmet and vest detected in at least 70% of their frames.
- Restricted-zone breach = a tracked person whose feet point enters a zone polygon for m
